questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "METICULOUS"
questions.explanation: METICULOUS का अर्थ होता है अत्यंत सावधान, सतर्क या सूक्ष्म। Synonym: Careful, Thorough, Precise, Fastidious.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "METICULOUS"
questions.explanation: METICULOUS (सावधान) का Antonym है Careless (लापरवाह) या Sloppy.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "CANDID"
questions.explanation: CANDID का अर्थ होता है निष्कपट, खरा या स्पष्टवादी। Synonym: Frank, Honest, Forthright.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "CANDID"
questions.explanation: CANDID (खरा/स्पष्ट) का Antonym है Deceitful (कपटी) या Secretive.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "FUGITIVE"
questions.explanation: FUGITIVE का अर्थ होता है भगोड़ा या कानून से भागा हुआ व्यक्ति। Synonym: Escapee, Runaway, Absconder.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "FUGITIVE"
questions.explanation: FUGITIVE (भगोड़ा) का Antonym है Captive (बंदी) या Prisoner.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "INNOCUOUS"
questions.explanation: INNOCUOUS का अर्थ होता है अहानिकर या सीधा-साधा। Synonym: Harmless, Inoffensive, Safe.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "INNOCUOUS"
questions.explanation: INNOCUOUS (अहानिकर) का Antonym है Harmful (हानिकारक) या Toxic.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A statement or expression open to more than one interpretation; unclear"
questions.explanation: दोगुने अर्थ वाले या अस्पष्ट कथन को Ambiguous (द्व्यर्थक/अस्पष्ट) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "The murder or killing of one's own father"
questions.explanation: पिता की हत्या करने की क्रिया/व्यक्ति को Patricide कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "The murder or killing of one's own mother"
questions.explanation: माता की हत्या करने को Matricide कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "The murder or killing of a king or queen"
questions.explanation: राजा या रानी की हत्या को Regicide राजहत्या कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "The murder or killing of a newly born infant/child"
questions.explanation: नवजात शिशु की हत्या को Infanticide कहते हैं (भ्रूण हत्या = Foeticide).

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "A leopard cannot change its spots"
options: It is easy to reform bad habits
A leopard changes color in winter
People cannot change their inherent basic character
questions.explanation: A leopard cannot change its spots = कुत्ते की दुम कभी सीधी नहीं होती, इंसान अपना मूल स्वभाव नहीं बदल सकता।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Beat around the bush"
options: Avoid coming directly to the main point
To hit the trees with stick
questions.explanation: Beat around the bush = मुद्दे पर सीधे न आकर घुमा फिराकर बात करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Bite the dust"
options: To suffer defeat or to die
To fall on the ground and get dirty
questions.explanation: Bite the dust = धूल चाटना, पराजित होना या मारा जाना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Burn bridges"
options: To destroy relationships so there is no way back
To set fire to a wooden bridge
questions.explanation: Burn bridges = वापसी के सभी रास्ते बंद कर देना/संबंध समाप्त कर लेना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Call it a day"
options: To stop working on something for the day
questions.explanation: Call it a day = उस दिन के लिए काम बंद करना/इतिश्री करना।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "He is one of those men who does not lie."
questions.explanation: Rule: Relative pronoun ('who') से पहले आने वाले Antecedent ('men' प्लुरल) के अनुसार वर्ब 'do' आएगी (who do not lie).

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "I, you and he will go to the party tonight."
questions.explanation: Rule: सामान्य वाक्यों में पर्शनल प्रोनाउन का क्रम 2-3-1 (You, he and I) होता है।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "The cattle is grazing in the green field."
questions.explanation: Rule: Noun 'Cattle' (मवेशी) सदैव प्लुरल नाउन है, इसके साथ प्लुरल वर्ब 'are' आएगी (The cattle are grazing).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He congratulated me _____ my success."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Congratulate' के साथ प्रपोजिशन 'on' आता है (Congratulated me on my success).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She is married _____ a famous doctor."
questions.explanation: Rule: Passive Voice में 'Married' के साथ हमेशा 'to' आता है (Married to a doctor).

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He insisted _____ going there immediately."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Insist' के साथ हमेशा प्रपोजिशन 'on' + Gerund आता है (Insisted on going).

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "EPHEMERAL"
questions.explanation: EPHEMERAL का अर्थ होता है अल्पकालिक, क्षणिक। Synonym: Short-lived, Transient, Fleeting.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "EPHEMERAL"
questions.explanation: EPHEMERAL (क्षणिक) का Antonym है Eternal (शाश्वत/अनंत) या Permanent.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "SAGACIOUS"
questions.explanation: SAGACIOUS का अर्थ होता है बुद्धिमान, चतुर या विवेकपूर्ण। Synonym: Wise, Shrewd, Intelligent, Insightful.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "SAGACIOUS"
questions.explanation: SAGACIOUS (बुद्धिमान) का Antonym है Foolish (मूर्ख) या Ignorant.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A doctor who specializes in the treatment of skin diseases"
questions.explanation: त्वचा विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर को Dermatologist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A medical specialist who treats diseases of the heart"
questions.explanation: हृदय रोग विशेषज्ञ को Cardiologist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A doctor who specializes in diseases of the eye"
questions.explanation: नेत्र रोग विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर को Ophthalmologist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A medical doctor specializing in the care and treatment of children"
questions.explanation: शिशु व बाल रोग विशेषज्ञ को Pediatrician कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Fit as a fiddle"
options: In very good physical health and condition
questions.explanation: Fit as a fiddle = पूर्णतः स्वस्थ व तंदुरुस्त।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "In hot water"
questions.explanation: In hot water = मुसीबत या परेशानी में होना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Let the cat out of the bag"
options: To reveal a secret prematurely or by mistake
To release a cat from a bag
questions.explanation: Let the cat out of the bag = जाने-अनजाने कोई गुप्त रहस्य उजागर कर देना।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "The patient <u>died</u> before the doctor arrived."
questions.explanation: Rule: भूतकाल में दो कार्य होने पर पहले समाप्त कार्य Past Perfect (had died) तथा बाद का Past Simple (arrived) बनता है।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "<u>Unless you do not hurry</u>, you will miss the train."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Unless' नकारात्मक शब्द है, इसके साथ 'do not' हटाकर केवल 'Unless you hurry' प्रयोग होगा।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "She wrote a poem."
options: A poem had been written by her.
A poem has been written by her.
A poem is written by her.
A poem was written by her.
questions.explanation: Past Simple का Passive = Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "People speak English all over the world."
options: People are spoken English all over the world.
English was spoken all over the world.
English is spoken all over the world.
English is being spoken all over the world.
questions.explanation: Present Simple का Passive = Object (English) + is + V3 (spoken) + remaining sentence.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said, "I have been waiting here for two hours."
options: He said that I had been waiting here for two hours.
He asked if he was waiting there.
He told he has been waiting there for two hours.
He said that he had been waiting there for two hours.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous (have been waiting) बदलकर Past Perfect Continuous (had been waiting) तथा 'here' का 'there' बनेगा।

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: She said to him, "Don't shout."
options: She ordered/told him not to shout.
She said to him don't shout.
She asked him to not shout.
She told him that don't shout.
questions.explanation: Imperative Negative ('Don't...') का Indirect = told/ordered + him + not to shout.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "LACONIC"
questions.explanation: LACONIC का अर्थ होता है संक्षिप्त, मितभाषी या कम शब्दों में। Synonym: Concise, Terse, Brief.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "LACONIC"
questions.explanation: LACONIC (संक्षिप्त) का Antonym है Verbose (शब्द-बहुल/बातूनी) या Wordy.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A vehicle specialized for carrying a dead body to a funeral"
questions.explanation: शव ले जाने वाली विशेष गाड़ी को Hearse (शववाहन) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A room or building where dead bodies are kept for post-mortem analysis"
questions.explanation: पोस्टमार्टम हेतु शवों को रखने के कक्ष को Mortuary कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A place where dead bodies are kept for identification before burial/cremation"
questions.explanation: पहचान हेतु लावारिस शवों को रखने के स्थान को Morgue (शवगृह) कहते हैं।

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी SUPERINTENDENT (अधीक्षक) है।
